audit_name: Audit Subagent 2 - Conversation Continuity & Frontend Integration

1_thread_id_generation.observed: In AgentDirectChatView.tsx lines 88-90 and 107, threads and activeThreadId initialize with or create IDs formatted as `thread-${agent.id}-${Date.now()}`.
1_thread_id_generation.code_snippet: const [activeThreadId, setActiveThreadId] = useState<string>(() => threads[0]?.id || `thread-${agent.id}-${Date.now()}`); const handleCreateNewThread = () => setActiveThreadId(`thread-${agent.id}-${Date.now()}`)

2_conversation_id_prop_passing.observed: At line 260 of AgentDirectChatView.tsx, AgentChatRuntime is passed conversationId as: `conversationId={activeThreadId.startsWith('conv_') ? activeThreadId : undefined}`.
2_conversation_id_prop_passing.impact: Because all newly created threads start with 'thread-', `activeThreadId.startsWith('conv_')` evaluates to false. Consequently, `conversationId` is passed as `undefined` to AgentChatRuntime and in turn to `api.streamAgentChat`.

3_backend_sse_and_missing_state_update.backend_behavior: In core/ui_server.py line 1576-1580, `_agent_chat_stream_handler` sends SSE event: 'done' with data containing `conversation_id: item.get('conversation_id')` (which is a real backend ID prefixed with 'conv_').
3_backend_sse_and_missing_state_update.frontend_handler: In AgentDirectChatView.tsx lines 305-341, the SSE consumer loops over chunks. When `chunk.type === 'done'`, it only checks `chunk.reply`. It completely ignores `chunk.conversation_id`.
3_backend_sse_and_missing_state_update.thread_completion: In lines 336-341, `onConversationComplete` is called, which invokes `handleConversationComplete` (lines 184-199). `handleConversationComplete` preserves `activeThreadId` (the original `thread-${agent.id}-${Date.now()}`) and never updates `activeThreadId` or the thread object with the backend's `conv_...` ID.
3_backend_sse_and_missing_state_update.impact: When the user types a second message in the same chat thread, `activeThreadId` is STILL `thread-...`, so `activeThreadId.startsWith('conv_')` remains false, and `conversationId` is passed as `undefined` AGAIN. The backend treats it as a brand-new conversation on turn 2, breaking server-side conversational continuity across consecutive user turns in the UI.

4_suite_e_testing_methodology.details: Inspection of tests/run_suite_e_tests.py (lines 56-135) reveals that E00_CORE_ALEX_DENTAL_SAAS was executed strictly via Scenario A (in-process Python AgentRuntime directly, with a mock ProviderAdapter and explicit conv_id = runtime.get_or_create_conversation()). It was NOT tested through the backend REST/SSE API, nor through the actual frontend AgentDirectChatView UI with consecutive messages.

conclusion.defect_summary: Frontend AgentDirectChatView fails to capture and store the backend `conversation_id` emitted by SSE `done` event. As a result, subsequent messages sent within the same thread always pass `conversationId: undefined`, creating isolated one-shot backend conversations instead of maintaining ongoing multi-turn context in live UI chat.
